# João Galego — Head of AI

[linkedin.com/in/jgalego](https://www.linkedin.com/in/jgalego/) | [github.com/JGalego](https://github.com/JGalego) | [jgalego.github.io](https://jgalego.github.io)

## Overview

João Galego is Head of AI at [Critical Software](https://www.criticalsoftware.com/) and Invited Professor at [Instituto Superior de Economia e Gestão (ISEG)](https://iseg.ulisboa.pt). He majored in Physics at [Instituto Superior Técnico (IST)](https://tecnico.ulisboa.pt/) in Lisbon and obtained a postgraduate diploma in Forensic Studies from [Instituto Superior de Ciências Sociais (ISCSP)](https://www.iscsp.ulisboa.pt/). He later pursued doctoral research in Cognitive Science, where he used machine learning (ML) to decode brain signals and study how thoughts turn into actions. Prior to joining Critical Software, João served as Lead ML Engineer at Siemens and held roles as Solutions Architect, ML Specialist, and Quantum Ambassador at AWS. At Critical Software, his mission is to bring ML to high‑stakes domains and build AI that solves real problems for real people. Outside of work and teaching, he can often be found browsing local bookstores, contributing to open-source projects, or spending quality time with his family.

## Articles

### Verified Tensor Operators for Safety-Critical ML: From Specification to Reference Implementation — J. Machado, R. Silva, L. Correnson, **J. Galego**, E. Jenn, H. Macedo, J. Souyris & J. Pinto (2026)

A Why3-based formal verification pipeline that turns high-level tensor operator specifications into provably correct C implementations for safety-critical ML systems. Paper accepted for publication at the [9th International Symposium on AI Verification](https://aiverification.org/2026) (SAIV2026) based on work developed as part of the Safe ONNX (SONNX) Working Group.

### Towards Verified Computation Graphs for Safety-Critical ML: From Static Model to Execution Semantics — J. Machado, R. Silva, **J. Galego**, E. Jenn, H. Macedo, & J. Pinto (2026)

A formal verification framework that models ONNX computation graphs with precise execution semantics and proves their correctness using a combination of Alloy-based model checking and Why3 deductive verification, enabling trustworthy execution of safety‑critical ML systems. Paper accepted for publication at the [8th International Workshop on AI and Formal Verification, Logic, Automata, and Synthesis](https://overlay.uniud.it/workshop/2026/) (OVERLAY2026 @ FLoC 2026) based on work developed as part of the Safe ONNX (SONNX) Working Group.

## Talks & Events

### Dependable AI in Airborne Systems — [7ª Ed. Jornadas Aeroespaciais](https://jornadasaeroespaciais.emfa.pt/) (2025)

L200 talk on the challenges of bringing AI into safety-critical embedded systems in aeronautics and other high-stakes domains.

### LLMs Under Siege: Red Teaming GenAI Applications — [Embrace:AI Meetup](https://jornadasaeroespaciais.emfa.pt/) (2025)

L300 session on how to anticipate threats, plan effective red team exercises, and bridge the gap between traditional cybersecurity and AI-specific challenges. Recording available on the [Embrace:AI Youtube channel](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=q4BYcFPlzTQ).

### O novo paradigma de GenAI com Amazon Bedrock — [AWS Generative AI Day](https://aws-experience.com/emea/iberia/e/ea5cb/generative-ai-day-evento-presencial-jornada-de-intelig%C3%AAncia-artificial-generativa) (2024)

L200 talk on Amazon Bedrock and GenAI for everyone.

### Demistifying ML with Amazon SageMaker: Agility, Speed and Efficiency — [AWS Cloud Experience Portugal](https://aws.amazon.com/events/cloud-experience-portugal) (2023)

L200 talk on low-code and no-code ML with Amazon SageMaker.

### How to solve common business challenges with AI/ML — [AWS Initiate Portugal 2022](https://pages.awscloud.com/InitiatePortugal_2022.html) (2022)

L200 talk featuring [Sérgio Casaleiro](https://www.linkedin.com/in/sergiocasaleiro/) (Software Development Manager at [Ryanair Labs](https://careers.ryanair.com/ryanair-labs-dublin/)) on how to leverage the [AWS ML Stack](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/whitepapers/latest/aws-overview/machine-learning.html) to solve common business problems and move an AI-powered application from PoC to production in no time.

### Amazon SageMaker for Startups — [AWS Experience Madrid on Floor 11](https://aws-experience.com/emea/madrid) (2022)

L300 talk on how to use [Amazon SageMaker](https://aws.amazon.com/sagemaker/) to manage the entire MLOps pipeline at scale - from data exploration and feature engineering to model deployment and monitoring - with a focus on cost optimization.

### Machine Learning for Medicine and Healthcare — [12th Workshop on Biomedical Engineering (WBME)](http://wbme.fc.ul.pt/) (2019)

An overview of what ML actually is, highlighting some of its applications to the health sector - from the rise of expert systems in the 80s to the diagnosis, prognosis and treatment of COVID-19 - how it is shaping the present and how it may one day decide our future. Slides are available [here](https://github.com/JGalego/WBME-ML-Workshop).
